meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一件大活拆给多个 AI 小组分头做,并盯着它们回报进度直到收尾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时有好几个 AI 任务在跑,需要有人分派、盯梢并汇总结果
copy.tagline_en: Split a big job across several AI workers and supervise them through to completion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run several AI tasks at once and need someone to dispatch, track and merge results

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Orca 运行时做多 agent 协调:线程消息、阻塞式问答、任务派发、等待 worker_done 与升级、任务 DAG、决策门,并把工作拆给多个 agent。执行命令前先选好本次会话的 CLI,并加载与该二进制版本匹配的指南。
howto.when: 当你需要结构化的多 agent 协调(如线程消息、任务派发、任务 DAG 等)时触发;若只是完整交接所有权或普通终端控制,原文要求改用 orca-cli 技能。

say.text: 把这几个子任务拆开,派给多个 Orca worker,并等它们回报结果。
say.note: 会启动协调循环并收集 worker_done

say.text: 用 Orca 跑一个任务 DAG,有依赖的任务按顺序执行。
say.note: 按 DAG 依赖关系派发任务

howto.what_en: Claude coordinates multiple agents via Orca runtime: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done waits, task DAGs, decision gates. Before acting it resolves the CLI and loads the version-matched guide.
howto.when_en: Triggers when structured multi-agent coordination is needed: threaded messages, task dispatch, task DAGs, etc. For full ownership handoffs or plain terminal control, use the orca-cli skill instead.

say_en.text: Split this into subtasks, dispatch to Orca workers, and wait for results.
say_en.note: Starts a coordinator loop and collects worker_done

say_en.text: Run this as a task DAG in Orca, with dependent tasks executing in order.
Send a threaded message to a worker and block until it replies.
